title_zh: Codebase-Memory-MCP 代码库记忆 MCP 服务器

paragraphs.en: Local code intelligence for developers and AI agents. Connect code, docs and infrastructure in a persistent graph, with CBM Lens, MCP tools, agent integrations and change-aware test selection.
paragraphs.zh: 面向开发者和 AI 智能体的本地代码智能。 将代码、文档和基础设施连接到一个持久化图谱中，并提供 CBM Lens、MCP 工具、智能体集成以及变更感知的测试选择。

sents.en: Local code intelligence for developers and AI agents.

sents.en: Connect code, docs and infrastructure in a persistent graph, with CBM Lens, MCP tools, agent integrations and change-aware test selection.

paragraphs.en: Understand your repository, from source code to the systems around it. codebase-memory-mcp is an MCP server that connects code, documentation, configuration, and infrastructure in a persistent local knowledge graph. Use it to find an unfamiliar feature, follow a call across services, trace a deployment back to its source, or assess which parts of a project a change could affect.
paragraphs.zh: 理解你的仓库，从源代码到围绕它的各个系统。codebase-memory-mcp 是一个 MCP 服务器，它将代码、文档、配置和基础设施连接到一个持久的本地知识图谱中。 用它来查找不熟悉的功能、追踪跨服务的调用、将某次部署追溯到其源代码，或评估一次更改可能影响项目的哪些部分。

paragraphs.en: Give your coding agent structural context through Model Context Protocol (MCP), or query the graph directly from the CLI. The MCP server is the core of the project. Its optional visual companion, CBM Lens, is in open beta (v0.0.1) , with a source reader, architecture maps, the Galaxy graph, coverage diagnostics, architecture decisions, and local code chat.
paragraphs.zh: 通过模型上下文协议（MCP）为你的编码智能体提供结构化上下文，或者直接从命令行界面（CLI）查询图数据。 MCP 服务器是本项目的核心。 其可选的可视化伴侣 CBM Lens 目前处于公开测试阶段（v0.0.1），包含源码阅读器、架构图、Galaxy 图、覆盖率诊断、架构决策以及本地代码对话功能。

paragraphs.en: The native C backend exposes 17 MCP tools , parses languages and file formats with vendored grammars, and adds Hybrid LSP type resolution for supported languages. The installer supports 45 automatic or conditional client integrations , including client configuration, skills, agent profiles, and applicable hooks. Indexing and graph queries need no hosted service or API key. Focused graph queries can reduce repeated file reads and token use; see the measured results .
paragraphs.zh: 原生 C 后端暴露 17 个 MCP 工具，使用内置语法解析语言和文件格式，并为受支持的语言添加混合 LSP 类型解析。 安装程序支持 45 种自动或有条件的客户端集成，包括客户端配置、技能、智能体配置文件以及适用的钩子。 索引和图查询不需要托管服务或 API 密钥。 聚焦的图查询可以减少重复的文件读取和令牌消耗；请参阅实测结果。

paragraphs.en: Local processing: Source analysis and graph storage run on your machine. CBM Lens can optionally download a model for browser AI after you enable it; inference stays on the device. The installer writes agent configuration for the clients you select. See Security for release verification and SECURITY.md for reporting issues.

paragraphs.en: Hook augmentation is context-only and fail-open: it does not replace or block the requested tool call. Features vary by client and platform; some clients use durable instructions or a parent-agent handoff instead of hooks or direct subagent MCP access. Codex users review and trust installed hooks through /hooks . See Multi-Agent Support and Sessions, compaction, and subagents for exact support and activation requirements.
paragraphs.zh: Hook 增强仅提供上下文且遵循“失败即放行”原则：它不会替换或阻止所请求的工具调用。 各功能因客户端和平台而异；某些客户端使用持久化指令或父智能体交接，而非 hooks 或直接的子智能体 MCP 访问。 Codex 用户通过 /hooks 审查并信任已安装的 hooks。 有关确切的支持与启用要求，请参见多智能体支持以及会话、压缩与子智能体相关文档。

paragraphs.en: CBM automatically shares one per-account coordination daemon across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and every other configured client. There is no opt-in setting for MCP servers or hook clients: the first daemon-backed CBM session starts it, each session registers its own work, and a session-managed daemon stops after the final session. A daemon started with daemon start remains running until stopped. The daemon owns long-lived background services such as watchers, shared indexing jobs, and the optional UI. Closing one session cancels work owned only by that session, while work still needed by another session continues.
paragraphs.zh: CBM 会自动在 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 以及所有其他已配置的客户端之间共享一个按账户划分的协调守护进程。 MCP 服务器或 hook 客户端没有任何可选加入的设置：第一个由守护进程支持的 CBM 会话会启动它，每个会话注册自己的工作，而由会话管理的守护进程会在最后一个会话结束后停止。 通过 daemon start 启动的守护进程会一直运行，直到被停止。 守护进程负责管理长期运行的后台服务，例如监视器、共享索引任务以及可选的 UI。 关闭一个会话会取消仅由该会话拥有的工作，而其他会话仍然需要的工作则会继续运行。

paragraphs.en: All active CBM processes must run the exact same version, executable build, coordination ABI, and canonical cache root. Equivalent CBM_CACHE_DIR aliases resolve to the same root; a genuinely different root is rejected while any CBM process is active. MCP servers, hooks, one-shot CLI commands, temporary index workers, and the daemon share a crash-safe OS admission barrier; starting an ordinary conflicting process fails before doing work and records an explicit conflict in ${CBM_CACHE_DIR}/logs/daemon-conflicts.ndjson .
paragraphs.zh: 所有活跃的 CBM 进程必须运行完全相同的版本、可执行构建、协调 ABI 以及规范缓存根目录。 等价的 CBM_CACHE_DIR 别名会解析到同一个根目录；只要有任一 CBM 进程处于活跃状态，真正不同的根目录就会被拒绝。 MCP 服务器、钩子、一次性 CLI 命令、临时索引工作进程以及守护进程共享一个防崩溃的操作系统准入屏障；启动普通冲突进程时会在执行任何工作之前失败，并在 ${CBM_CACHE_DIR}/logs/daemon-conflicts.ndjson 中记录明确的冲突。

paragraphs.en: The native install and uninstall commands are the deliberate exception to that conflict rule. For installation, download, verification, and private same-filesystem staging finish before activation so a bad candidate never disrupts active work. The native update command prints the installer command that performs the update. Activation then publishes account-wide maintenance intent, asks the daemon and every temporary local operation to cancel, and waits to a finite deadline for all coordinated CBM processes to exit. It holds the admission and lifetime barriers exclusively while changing the active binary, configuration, PATH, or indexes. New CBM work cannot enter during this window. Activation progress and results are recorded in ${CBM_CACHE_DIR}/logs/activation-events.ndjson , and a successful command tells you to restart open coding-agent sessions so they launch the activated build.
paragraphs.zh: 原生的安装与卸载命令是该冲突规则的有意例外。 在安装方面，下载、校验以及私有的同文件系统暂存会在激活之前完成，因此不合格的候选版本绝不会干扰正在进行的操作。 原生的 update 命令会打印出执行更新的安装命令。 随后，激活过程会发布账户级的维护意图，请求守护进程和所有临时本地操作取消，并在有限的截止时间内等待所有协同的 CBM 进程退出。 在更改活动二进制文件、配置、PATH 或索引时，它独占地持有准入与生命周期屏障。 在此窗口期间，新的 CBM 工作无法进入。 激活的进度和结果会记录在 ${CBM_CACHE_DIR}/logs/activation-events.ndjson 中，命令成功后它会提示你重启已打开的 coding-agent 会话，以便它们启动已激活的构建版本。

paragraphs.en: The ordinary cli mode runs one command locally, but it is not disconnected from the daemon above: it connects to the shared coordination daemon (starting one if none is already running) for that same admission barrier plus per-project locks on graph mutations. Its connection is a cli_session : it does not register a project watcher or open a browser, and it holds the admission lease only for the command's lifetime. The shared daemon may serve Lens according to its UI configuration and available assets. If the command's own connection is what started the daemon, that daemon exits again once the command closes and no other session is attached; if a daemon was already running, the command simply joins and leaves it exactly as found. While the command is running, a temporary monitor separately lets activation cancel that operation and its supervised worker safely; the monitor exits with the command and never becomes a standing daemon. See CLI Mode for details.
paragraphs.zh: 普通的 cli 模式在本地运行一条命令，但它并未与上述守护进程断开连接：它会连接到共享的协调守护进程（如果没有正在运行的则启动一个），以获得同样的准入屏障以及针对图变更的按项目锁。 它的连接是一个 cli_session：它不会注册项目监视器或打开浏览器，并且只在命令的生命周期内持有准入租约。 共享守护进程可以根据其 UI 配置和可用资源提供 Lens。 如果命令自身的连接正是启动守护进程的那个，那么一旦命令关闭且没有其他会话接入，该守护进程就会再次退出；如果守护进程已经在运行，命令只是加入它，并在离开时保持其原样。 在命令运行期间，一个临时监视器让激活操作可以安全地取消该操作及其受监管的智能体（worker）；该监视器随命令一同退出，绝不会变成常驻守护进程。 详情请参阅 CLI Mode。

paragraphs.en: Drag a 3D view to orbit, scroll to zoom, and select a node or edge to inspect it. Edge colors distinguish relationships, and pulses indicate their direction. Reduced-motion preferences pause the pulses. Large views show their limits and omitted counts. A missing edge can reflect an indexing or display limit, so check Coverage and the source before drawing conclusions.

paragraphs.en: Each initialized, long-lived MCP session can register its root project when it connects and any target from a successful index_repository call, including custom project names and roots in another worktree. While auto_watch is enabled, these watches belong to the registering sessions and remain while at least one owning session is connected; closing the last owner removes the watch. An async index registers its target only after success and while its requesting session remains connected. CLI indexing and failed MCP indexes do not register watches. Global auto_watch controls registration and removes all watches on the next refresh or registration request when set to false . index_status reports this in its watch object: watched , and either the poll cadence and last scan time or the reason it is not watched.
paragraphs.zh: 每个已初始化的长期存续的 MCP 会话可以在连接时注册其根项目，以及来自成功 index_repository 调用的任意目标，包括自定义项目名称和位于另一个 worktree 中的根目录。 当 auto_watch 启用时，这些监视项归属于注册它们的会话，并且只要至少有一个所属会话保持连接就会一直存在；当最后一个所属会话关闭时会移除该监视项。 异步索引只有在成功完成且其请求会话仍保持连接时才会注册其目标。 CLI 索引和失败的 MCP 索引不会注册监视项。 全局 auto_watch 控制注册，并在设置为 false 时在下一次刷新或注册请求时移除所有监视项。index_status 在其 watch 对象中报告这一点：watched，以及轮询节奏和上次扫描时间，或者未受监视的原因。

paragraphs.en: Updates run from the install script on every platform, not from inside the running binary. codebase-memory-mcp update validates your flags and then prints the exact command to run:
paragraphs.zh: 更新操作在所有平台上均由安装脚本执行，而非在运行中的二进制文件内进行。codebase-memory-mcp update 会先校验你的参数，然后打印出需要运行的确切命令：

paragraphs.en: # macOS / Linux bash " <install-dir>/install.sh " # Windows powershell - File " <install-dir>\install.ps1 " The install script is placed next to the binary at install time, so the printed path resolves beside the executable. It is idempotent, so re-running it is the update: it stops the daemon, retires the running binary, installs the new one, and cleans up.
paragraphs.zh: # macOS / Linux bash " <install-dir>/install.sh " # Windows powershell - File " <install-dir>\install.ps1 " 安装脚本在安装时会放置在二进制文件旁边，因此打印出的路径会解析到可执行文件旁边的位置。 它是幂等的，因此重新运行它即是更新：它会停止守护进程，退役正在运行的二进制文件，安装新的二进制文件，并进行清理。

sents.en: # macOS / Linux bash " <install-dir>/install.sh " # Windows powershell - File " <install-dir>\install.ps1 " The install script is placed next to the binary at install time, so the printed path resolves beside the executable.

sents.en: It is idempotent, so re-running it is the update: it stops the daemon, retires the running binary, installs the new one, and cleans up.
sents.zh: 它是幂等的，因此重新运行它即是更新：它会停止守护进程，退役正在运行的二进制文件，安装新的二进制文件，并进行清理。

paragraphs.en: Why it works this way. On Windows it is a hard requirement; a running executable cannot replace its own image, so the swap has to happen from a process that is not the binary being replaced. On macOS and Linux it is a deliberate choice: an in-process updater is structurally a downloader (fetch an archive, verify it, unpack it, mark a file executable, run it), and shipping that composite in every binary to serve a command most people run a handful of times is a poor trade. The release archives now carry no download URLs at all, and cbm makes no network request of its own accord : it does not check for new versions in the background, and nothing phones home. You find out about releases from the install script, your package manager, or GitHub.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么它以这种方式运作。 在 Windows 上这是一条硬性要求：正在运行的可执行文件无法替换自身的映像，因此替换必须由一个并非被替换二进制文件的进程来执行。 在 macOS 和 Linux 上则是一种有意的选择：进程内更新器在结构上就是一个下载器（获取压缩包、校验、解压、将某个文件标记为可执行、运行它），把这样一个组合功能放进每个二进制文件里，去服务一个大多数人只运行寥寥几次的命令，是一笔不划算的买卖。 发布压缩包现在完全不包含任何下载 URL，cbm 也不会自发发起任何网络请求：它不在后台检查新版本，也没有任何回传数据的动作。 你通过安装脚本、包管理器或 GitHub 来获知新版本的发布。

sents.en: Why it works this way.
sents.zh: 为什么它以这种方式运作。

sents.en: On Windows it is a hard requirement; a running executable cannot replace its own image, so the swap has to happen from a process that is not the binary being replaced.
sents.zh: 在 Windows 上这是一条硬性要求：正在运行的可执行文件无法替换自身的映像，因此替换必须由一个并非被替换二进制文件的进程来执行。

sents.en: On macOS and Linux it is a deliberate choice: an in-process updater is structurally a downloader (fetch an archive, verify it, unpack it, mark a file executable, run it), and shipping that composite in every binary to serve a command most people run a handful of times is a poor trade.
sents.zh: 在 macOS 和 Linux 上则是一种有意的选择：进程内更新器在结构上就是一个下载器（获取压缩包、校验、解压、将某个文件标记为可执行、运行它），把这样一个组合功能放进每个二进制文件里，去服务一个大多数人只运行寥寥几次的命令，是一笔不划算的买卖。

sents.en: The release archives now carry no download URLs at all, and cbm makes no network request of its own accord : it does not check for new versions in the background, and nothing phones home.
sents.zh: 发布压缩包现在完全不包含任何下载 URL，cbm 也不会自发发起任何网络请求：它不在后台检查新版本，也没有任何回传数据的动作。

paragraphs.en: codebase-memory-mcp indexes and queries locally and collects no telemetry . When you hit something we can't reproduce on our side (a slow memory climb over hours, a performance regression, a leak that only appears after days of real use), we have no diagnostic data unless you choose to send it. Here is how to capture it yourself.
paragraphs.zh: codebase-memory-mcp 在本地进行索引和查询，不收集任何遥测数据。 当你遇到我们这边无法复现的问题时（例如持续数小时的内存缓慢攀升、性能回退，或只有经过数天真实使用才出现的泄漏），除非你选择主动发送，否则我们没有任何诊断数据。 以下是自行捕获诊断数据的方法。

sents.en: Here is how to capture it yourself.
sents.zh: 以下是自行捕获诊断数据的方法。

paragraphs.en: Set CBM_DIAGNOSTICS=1 before the first daemon-backed MCP session starts, then reproduce the problem (let it run as long as it takes; a slow leak needs time to show in the trend). The shared daemon captures this setting from the session that starts it. If it is already running, close all daemon-backed sessions so it exits before changing the setting. The daemon creates a fresh owner-private cbm-diagnostics-<pid>-<random> directory below the system temp directory ( $TMPDIR or /tmp on macOS/Linux, %TEMP% on Windows). The exact paths are recorded by the diagnostics.start event in ${CBM_CACHE_DIR}/logs/cbm-daemon.log :
paragraphs.zh: 在第一个由守护进程支持的 MCP 会话启动之前设置 CBM_DIAGNOSTICS=1，然后复现问题（让它运行足够长的时间；缓慢的泄漏需要时间才能在趋势中显现）。 共享守护进程会从启动它的那个会话中捕获此设置。 如果它已在运行，请先关闭所有由守护进程支持的会话使其退出，然后再更改该设置。 守护进程会在系统临时目录下（macOS/Linux 上的 $TMPDIR 或 /tmp，Windows 上的 %TEMP%）创建一个全新的所有者私有的 cbm-diagnostics-<pid>-<random> 目录。 具体路径由 ${CBM_CACHE_DIR}/logs/cbm-daemon.log 中的 diagnostics.start 事件记录：

paragraphs.en: When you open a memory/performance issue, attach the .ndjson trajectory : it contains no source code or query text, only resource counters. paragraphs.en: Every direct tier batches check_index_coverage for its evidence paths and reads flagged ranges or skipped/excluded files directly. A clean coverage result means only “no recorded gap,” never proof of completeness. Clients without safe child MCP access receive the same three tiers as parent-handoff agents; the parent must supply project, generation, pagination state, graph evidence, and coverage results. Updates migrate only byte-identical prior Verify definitions and never overwrite user-modified agents.

paragraphs.en: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and VS Code's Copilot runtime receive paired session/subagent context where the vendor exposes a documented context-output contract. Codex users must review and trust installed hooks through /hooks ; changing a hook definition changes its trust hash, so an update can require re-trust. Qoder uses SessionStart , SubagentStart , and post- Read coverage, including its documented PowerShell executor on Windows. Kimi uses UserPromptSubmit , while Hermes uses pre_llm_call ; both retain their documented Windows execution paths. Devin installs UserPromptSubmit and PostCompaction on macOS/Linux and adds SessionStart only when Claude's equivalent managed hook is not present. GitLab Duo gets a narrowly scoped macOS/Linux user SessionStart entry on its experimental hook surface. GitLab Duo, Devin, and Factory hooks are withheld on Windows because those vendors do not document a deterministic shell/executor contract there. Gemini CLI, Factory Droid, and Augment also add documented post-read/view coverage context but expose no equivalent documented child-start context.
paragraphs.zh: 当厂商公开了有文档说明的上下文输出契约时，Claude Code、Codex CLI、Qwen Code、GitHub Copilot CLI 以及 VS Code 的 Copilot 运行时会接收成对的会话/子智能体上下文。 Codex 用户必须通过 /hooks 审查并信任已安装的钩子；修改钩子的定义会改变其信任哈希，因此更新后可能需要重新信任。 Qoder 使用 SessionStart、SubagentStart 以及 Read 之后的覆盖，包括其在 Windows 上有文档说明的 PowerShell 执行器。 Kimi 使用 UserPromptSubmit，而 Hermes 使用 pre_llm_call；两者都保留了其有文档说明的 Windows 执行路径。 Devin 在 macOS/Linux 上安装 UserPromptSubmit 和 PostCompaction，并且仅当 Claude 的等效托管钩子不存在时才添加 SessionStart。 GitLab Duo 在其实验性钩子界面上获得了一个作用域狭窄的 macOS/Linux 用户级 SessionStart 条目。 GitLab Duo、Devin 和 Factory 的钩子在 Windows 上不予提供，因为这些厂商在 Windows 上没有文档说明确定性的 shell/执行器契约。 Gemini CLI、Factory Droid 和 Augment 也添加了有文档说明的读取/查看之后的覆盖上下文，但没有公开等效的有文档说明的子智能体启动上下文。

paragraphs.en: For runtimes without a stable context-producing lifecycle event, durable files carry the contract across fresh sessions and compaction: verify the graph project and index freshness, query structural facts in the parent, then pass the project, qualified symbols, paths, and call-chain evidence in every delegated task. Claude, Codex, Gemini, Kiro, Qwen, Copilot, CodeBuddy, OpenCode, Kilo, Vibe, Qoder, Junie, Factory, and Grok Build receive Scout, Verify, and Auditor graph profiles. Kiro embeds this MCP server with --tool-profile scout for Scout and --tool-profile analysis for Verify/Auditor. Junie registers equivalent named server aliases because its subagent schema filters by server rather than by individual tool. Both process profiles use positive allowlists: Scout exposes seven fast inspection tools, Analysis exposes eleven, and future or mutating tools remain unavailable until explicitly reviewed. If either Junie alias collides with user configuration, the installer preserves it and installs parent-handoff profiles instead. Qoder combines its documented named-server selection with exact tier-specific MCP tool IDs. Factory uses exact registered MCP tool IDs without its additive mcpServers field, which would expose the whole server. Codex, Kilo, Vibe, and other capable formats likewise enumerate the narrowest supported tool set. Rovo, Cursor, Augment, Pochi, and Cline use parent handoff where direct child MCP is unavailable or unsafe; Pochi is limited to readFile , and Cline child agents cannot use MCP.
paragraphs.zh: 对于没有稳定的上下文生成生命周期事件的运行时，持久化文件在全新会话和压缩过程中承载该契约：验证图项目和索引的新鲜度，在父级查询结构性事实，然后在每个委派任务中传递项目、限定符号、路径和调用链证据。 Claude、Codex、Gemini、Kiro、Qwen、Copilot、CodeBuddy、OpenCode、Kilo、Vibe、Qoder、Junie、Factory 和 Grok Build 接收 Scout、Verify 和 Auditor 图配置。 Kiro 以 --tool-profile scout 嵌入此 MCP 服务器用于 Scout，以 --tool-profile analysis 用于 Verify/Auditor。 Junie 注册等效的具名服务器别名，因为其子智能体模式按服务器而非按单个工具进行过滤。 两个进程配置均使用正向允许列表：Scout 暴露七个快速检查工具，Analysis 暴露十一个，未来的或具有变更性的工具在经过明确审查之前保持不可用。 如果任一 Junie 别名与用户配置冲突，安装程序会保留该配置并改为安装父级交接配置。 Qoder 将其文档中记载的具名服务器选择机制与精确的层专属 MCP 工具 ID 相结合。 Factory 使用精确的已注册 MCP 工具 ID，而不使用其附加的 mcpServers 字段，因为该字段会暴露整个服务器。 Codex、Kilo、Vibe 以及其他具备能力的格式同样枚举最窄的受支持工具集。 在直接子级 MCP 不可用或不安全时，Rovo、Cursor、Augment、Pochi 和 Cline 使用父级交接；Pochi 仅限于 readFile，而 Cline 的子智能体无法使用 MCP。

paragraphs.en: Cline's file hooks auto-activate when present, and current Cline does not reliably consume their context output, so automatic adapters are withheld and older owned adapters are cleaned up. CodeBuddy's beta, version-gated hooks are not auto-installed. Junie's EAP SessionStart output is documented as ignored, so no context hook is installed. Junie custom agents remain EAP-dependent. Qoder can resolve higher-priority project or plugin agents before user agents with the same name; reload the client after installation or profile changes. Cursor context hooks are withheld: session context injection has a known race, subagentStart is control-only, and read-only subagents cannot safely receive MCP access. Grok Build's passive hook events ( SessionStart , SubagentStart , PostToolUse ) discard stdout and PreToolUse honors only deny/rewrite decisions, so its context hooks are withheld; Grok also reads Claude and Cursor MCP, skill, and hook files through its compat layer, and the native config.toml entry shadows that copy by name. Rovo has no documented session context-output hook, and Bob documents neither a suitable hook nor a custom-agent surface. Those surfaces are not approximated with invented augmentation. Kimi plugins, Amp plugins, and GitLab experimental global skills remain opt-in.

paragraphs.en: Every MCP tool can be invoked as a local, one-shot command. CLI tools connect to the shared coordination daemon (starting one if none is already running) to get a crash-safe exact-build admission lease for the command's lifetime; they never register with the background watcher, and a daemon a command had to start itself exits again once the command's connection closes and no other session is using it. index_repository is the only exception internally: it starts a temporary, exact-build supervised worker for the index, then stops that worker before the CLI command exits; the worker holds its own lease until exit.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 MCP 工具都可以作为本地的一次性命令来调用。 CLI 工具会连接到共享的协调守护进程（若尚无守护进程在运行则启动一个），以获取一个崩溃安全、精确构建的准入租约，租约持续到命令生命周期结束；它们从不在后台监视器中注册，而命令自行启动的守护进程会在命令的连接关闭且没有其他会话使用它时再次退出。index_repository 在内部是唯一的例外：它会为索引起动一个临时的、精确构建的受管工作进程，然后在 CLI 命令退出之前停止该工作进程；该工作进程持有自己的租约直到退出。

paragraphs.en: When stderr is an interactive terminal, the CLI automatically shows lifecycle and indexing progress. Pass --progress to force the same feedback when stderr is redirected or the command is run non-interactively. Pass --quiet to disable automatic terminal progress and ordinary diagnostics while retaining errors; it cannot be combined with --progress or outer cli --verbose . Routine informational logs are quiet by default; pass outer cli --verbose to include them. Progress and logs use stderr while stdout remains reserved for the command result. Read tools return a compact tree by default; pass a tool's --format json for machine-readable payload JSON, or outer --json for the full MCP envelope.

paragraphs.en: Large compact-tree tables may start with a response-local <section>_refs directory and an explicit <section>_ref_rule . A cell such as @0+handler.go reconstructs to ref 0 's prefix plus handler.go . References are local to that sibling <section> table and expansion is non-recursive: entries inside <section>_refs are always literal prefixes. This is limited to declared path and qualified-name columns and activates only when the exact rendered table is at least 15% and 64 bytes smaller and a conservative model-neutral token-shape proxy also improves by at least 1%. Search and trace likewise render direct and prefix-grouped tree shapes and keep the smaller complete representation, so singleton or scattered answers do not pay directory overhead. Keys are declared once per table but never cryptically abbreviated, and --format json keeps stable literal strings for machine consumers. Both gates are deterministic; exact token counts still depend on the caller's tokenizer.
paragraphs.zh: 大型紧凑树形表可能以响应局部的 <section>_refs 目录和一个显式的 <section>_ref_rule 开头。 像 @0+handler.go 这样的单元格会重构为引用 0 的前缀加上 handler.go 。 引用仅限于该同级 <section> 表内，且展开是非递归的：<section>_refs 内的条目始终是字面前缀。 这仅限于已声明的路径列和限定名列，并且只有当精确渲染的表至少缩小 15% 和 64 字节，且一个保守的模型无关的词元形态代理指标也至少提升 1% 时才会激活。 搜索和追踪同样渲染直接和前缀分组的树形结构，并保留更小的完整表示，因此单个或分散的答案不会付出目录开销。 键在每个表中只声明一次，但绝不会以晦涩的方式缩写，并且 --format json 为机器消费者保留稳定的字面字符串。 两个门槛都是确定性的；精确的词元计数仍取决于调用方的分词器。

paragraphs.en: Lean responses truncate semantically, never by cutting arbitrary bytes from code or identifiers. Ranked graph rows are retained ahead of raw grep rows and diagnostic summaries; omitted rows/sections report totals, has_more , and a strictly advancing continuation offset or cursor. If even the first whole row cannot fit, CBM asks for a higher budget and emits no self-looping cursor. max_output_tokens is model-neutral sizing guidance: CBM enforces a deterministic ceiling of four UTF-8 bytes per requested token, so it is not a tokenizer-exact count. Detail flags such as diagnostics , source_mode , and detail opt into heavier fields. search_code pages ranked rows with result_limit / result_offset ( limit remains a compatibility alias), raw rows with raw_limit / raw_offset , and directory summaries with directory_limit / directory_offset . Raw lines default to a UTF-8-safe match-centered preview; each row reports content_start_byte , returned/total byte counts, match byte bounds when known, and a content continuation offset. Pass raw_content_offset to page the original line without moving the raw-row cursor. match_limit and source_max_lines bound per-result details, with exact omission metadata. detect_changes pages changed files, impacted symbols, and module summaries independently; prefer its snapshot-bound *_cursor continuations, which reject changed commits, worktree bytes, graph generation, or semantic arguments instead of silently skipping or duplicating rows.
paragraphs.zh: 精简响应在语义处截断，绝不通过从代码或标识符中切掉任意字节来截断。 排序后的图谱行优先于原始 grep 行和诊断摘要保留；被省略的行/节会报告总数、has_more 以及严格递进的 continuation offset 或 cursor。 如果连第一整行都无法容纳，CBM 会请求更高的预算，并且不发出自循环的 cursor。max_output_tokens 是与模型无关的尺寸指导：CBM 对每个请求 token 强制执行四字节 UTF-8 的确定性上限，因此它不是精确的分词器计数。 诸如 diagnostics、source_mode 和 detail 之类的细节标志用于启用更重的字段。search_code 使用 result_limit / result_offset（limit 仍是兼容性别名）对排序后的行进行分页，使用 raw_limit / raw_offset 对原始行分页，并使用 directory_limit / directory_offset 对目录摘要分页。 原始行默认为 UTF-8 安全、以匹配为中心的预览；每行报告 content_start_byte、返回/总字节数、已知时的匹配字节边界以及内容 continuation offset。 传入 raw_content_offset 以对原始行进行分页而不移动 raw-row cursor。match_limit 和 source_max_lines 限制每个结果的细节，并提供精确的省略元数据。detect_changes 独立地对变更文件、受影响符号和模块摘要分页；优先使用其绑定快照的 *_cursor 续传，这些续传会拒绝变更的提交、工作区字节、图谱生成或语义参数，而不是静默跳过或重复行。

sents.en: Raw lines default to a UTF-8-safe match-centered preview; each row reports content_start_byte , returned/total byte counts, match byte bounds when known, and a content continuation offset.

sents.en: Pass raw_content_offset to page the original line without moving the raw-row cursor. match_limit and source_max_lines bound per-result details, with exact omission metadata. detect_changes pages changed files, impacted symbols, and module summaries independently; prefer its snapshot-bound *_cursor continuations, which reject changed commits, worktree bytes, graph generation, or semantic arguments instead of silently skipping or duplicating rows.
sents.zh: 传入 raw_content_offset 以对原始行进行分页而不移动 raw-row cursor。match_limit 和 source_max_lines 限制每个结果的细节，并提供精确的省略元数据。detect_changes 独立地对变更文件、受影响符号和模块摘要分页；优先使用其绑定快照的 *_cursor 续传，这些续传会拒绝变更的提交、工作区字节、图谱生成或语义参数，而不是静默跳过或重复行。

paragraphs.en: Every response is standard UTF-8. Identifiers, paths, and raw search previews preserve POSIX byte-string identities: a preserved value containing malformed UTF-8 is emitted reversibly as @bytes:<lowercase hex of every original byte> . A valid preserved value that literally begins with the reserved @bytes: or @utf8: prefix is emitted as @utf8:<original value> , so decoding is unambiguous: strip one @utf8: prefix for literal UTF-8, or hex-decode one @bytes: prefix for original bytes. Ordinary valid UTF-8 is unchanged and pays no output-token overhead. To keep code readable, source bodies replace malformed UTF-8 with U+FFFD; use the pageable raw search preview when byte-exact source inspection is required.
paragraphs.zh: 每个响应都是标准 UTF-8。 标识符、路径和原始搜索预览保留 POSIX 字节串同一性：包含格式错误 UTF-8 的被保留值会以可逆方式输出为 @bytes:<每个原始字节的小写十六进制>。 一个字面以保留前缀 @bytes: 或 @utf8: 开头的有效被保留值会输出为 @utf8:<原始值>，因此解码是无歧义的：去掉一个 @utf8: 前缀即得到字面 UTF-8，或对一个 @bytes: 前缀做十六进制解码即得到原始字节。 普通的有效 UTF-8 保持不变，不产生任何输出 token 开销。 为了保持代码可读，源代码正文会将格式错误的 UTF-8 替换为 U+FFFD；当需要按字节精确检查源代码时，请使用可分页的原始搜索预览。

paragraphs.en: Long indexes and client call deadlines. A synchronous index_repository on a large repository can take longer than an MCP client allows one tool call (some IDE clients give up after a fixed deadline). When a client cancels or disconnects, the daemon cancels an index that nobody else is waiting for, so retrying the same blocking call never finishes. Use the async mode instead:
paragraphs.zh: 长时间运行的索引与客户端调用的截止时间。 在大型仓库上执行同步的 index_repository 可能比 MCP 客户端允许的单次工具调用时间更长（某些 IDE 客户端会在固定截止时间后放弃等待）。 当客户端取消或断开连接时，守护进程会取消一个没有其他人等待的索引，因此重试同一个阻塞调用永远无法完成。 请改用异步模式：

paragraphs.en: async and status are exclusive; async does not apply to cross-repo-intelligence . Both need the daemon-backed server (the default codebase-memory-mcp entry point). A temporary daemon (started on demand rather than by codebase-memory-mcp daemon start ) stops, and cancels its jobs, when its last client disconnects. A connected MCP session keeps it alive, so async from your editor works. A one-shot codebase-memory-mcp cli index_repository --async that is the daemon's only client is refused with a clear error, because the job would die the moment the command exits: run codebase-memory-mcp daemon start first, keep an MCP session open, or call without --async . status works everywhere. When a synchronous call was cut short, the next index_repository or status call for that project carries a notice suggesting the async mode. index_status keeps describing the published graph and its freshness.
paragraphs.zh: async 和 status 互斥；async 不适用于 cross-repo-intelligence。 两者都需要由守护进程支持的服务器（默认的 codebase-memory-mcp 入口点）。 临时守护进程（按需启动而非通过 codebase-memory-mcp daemon start 启动的）在最后一个客户端断开连接时会停止，并取消其任务。 已连接的 MCP 会话会使其保持存活，因此从编辑器发起的 async 调用可以正常工作。 一次性执行的 codebase-memory-mcp cli index_repository --async 若是守护进程的唯一客户端，会被拒绝并收到明确的错误提示，因为任务会在命令退出时立即终止：请先运行 codebase-memory-mcp daemon start，保持一个 MCP 会话开启，或不带 --async 调用。status 在任何地方都可用。 当同步调用被中途截断时，对该项目的下一次 index_repository 或 status 调用会附带提示，建议使用 async 模式。index_status 仍会描述已发布的图及其新鲜度。

paragraphs.en: manage_adr query modes ( get and sections ) use the server's cached query store so they can proceed while a same-project reindex is running. If another process publishes a replacement store during reindexing, they can return the pre-publication ADR until idle eviction refreshes that cache. Updates remain serialized through the project mutation guard.
paragraphs.zh: manage_adr 的查询模式（get 和 sections）使用服务器缓存的查询存储，因此在同一项目重建索引运行期间它们仍可继续执行。 如果在重建索引期间另一个进程发布了替换后的存储，它们可能返回发布前的 ADR，直到空闲驱逐刷新该缓存。 更新仍通过项目变更守卫进行串行化处理。

paragraphs.en: Environment used by daemon-owned components (such as diagnostics, daemon logging, and process-wide indexing resource limits) is captured from the first daemon-backed session that starts the daemon. Later sessions join that process and cannot replace those values. To change them, close all daemon-backed sessions, update the relevant agent configurations consistently, and restart a session. CBM_ALLOWED_ROOT remains session-specific, a conflicting CBM_CACHE_DIR is rejected, and a one-shot CLI command is not exempt from the rule above: it connects to the coordination daemon like any other session, starting one if none is running. Its own environment becomes the captured daemon-owned environment only when its invocation is the one that starts the daemon; joining an already-running daemon, it inherits that daemon's already-captured values instead.
paragraphs.zh: 守护进程所辖组件（如诊断、守护进程日志和进程级索引资源限制）所使用的环境，取自启动该守护进程的第一个由守护进程支持的会话。 后续会话会加入该进程，无法替换这些值。 若要更改它们，请关闭所有由守护进程支持的会话，一致地更新相关智能体配置，然后重新启动一个会话。 CBM_ALLOWED_ROOT 仍然是会话特定的，冲突的 CBM_CACHE_DIR 会被拒绝，而且一次性 CLI 命令也不能豁免上述规则：它与其他任何会话一样连接到协调守护进程，如果没有守护进程在运行则启动一个。 只有当该命令的调用是启动守护进程的那一次时，它自身的环境才会成为被捕获的守护进程所辖环境；若加入的是已在运行的守护进程，它将改为继承该守护进程已捕获的值。

paragraphs.en: codebase-memory-mcp ships a lightweight C implementation of language type-resolution algorithms, structurally inspired by and compatible with major language servers (tsserver / typescript-go, pyright, gopls, Roslyn, Eclipse JDT, rust-analyzer), embedded directly into the native executable. No language server process, no per-project setup, no API key. We call this layer Hybrid LSP : it runs alongside tree-sitter on every parse and refines invocation resolution ( CALLS / RESOLVED_CALLS ) and callable-value resolution ( CALL_REFERENCE , with ambiguous values retained as USAGE ) using type information, so the resulting graph mirrors what an IDE "Go to Definition" would resolve.
paragraphs.zh: codebase-memory-mcp 内置了一个轻量级的 C 语言实现，用于语言类型解析算法，其结构受主流语言服务器（tsserver / typescript-go、pyright、gopls、Roslyn、Eclipse JDT、rust-analyzer）启发并与之兼容，直接嵌入到原生可执行文件中。 无需语言服务器进程，无需按项目进行配置，无需 API 密钥。 我们将这一层称为 Hybrid LSP：它在每次解析时与 tree-sitter 一同运行，并利用类型信息细化调用解析（CALLS / RESOLVED_CALLS）和可调用值解析（CALL_REFERENCE，有歧义的值保留为 USAGE），使生成的图与 IDE 中「转到定义」的解析结果保持一致。

paragraphs.en: src/ main.c Entry point (MCP stdio server + CLI + install/update/config) daemon/ Per-account session coordination, IPC, lifecycle, shared jobs/watchers mcp/ MCP server (17 tools, JSON-RPC 2.0, session detection, auto-index) cli/ Install/uninstall/update/config (45 client surfaces, hooks, instructions) store/ SQLite graph storage (nodes, edges, traversal, search, Louvain) pipeline/ Multi-pass indexing (structure → definitions → calls → HTTP links → config → tests) cypher/ Cypher query lexer, parser, planner, executor discover/ File discovery (.gitignore, .cbmignore, symlink handling) watcher/ Background auto-sync (git polling, adaptive intervals) traces/ Runtime trace ingestion ui/ Local HTTP server + embedded CBM Lens frontend foundation/ Platform abstractions (threads, filesystem, logging, memory) graph-ui/ CodeAtlasWeb: React, Monaco, and Three.js browser frontend internal/cbm/ Vendored tree-sitter grammars (162 languages) + AST extraction engine Security Every release is verified through a multi-layer pipeline before publication:
paragraphs.zh: src/ main.c 入口点（MCP stdio 服务器 + CLI + 安装/更新/配置） daemon/ 按账户的会话协调、IPC、生命周期、共享任务/监视器 mcp/ MCP 服务器（17 个工具、JSON-RPC 2.0、会话检测、自动索引） cli/ 安装/卸载/更新/配置（45 个客户端界面、钩子、说明） store/ SQLite 图存储（节点、边、遍历、搜索、Louvain） pipeline/ 多阶段索引（结构 → 定义 → 调用 → HTTP 链接 → 配置 → 测试） cypher/ Cypher 查询词法分析器、解析器、规划器、执行器 discover/ 文件发现（.gitignore、.cbmignore、符号链接处理） watcher/ 后台自动同步（git 轮询、自适应间隔） traces/ 运行时追踪摄入 ui/ 本地 HTTP 服务器 + 内嵌的 CBM Lens 前端 foundation/ 平台抽象（线程、文件系统、日志、内存） graph-ui/ CodeAtlasWeb：React、Monaco 和 Three.js 浏览器前端 internal/cbm/ 内置（vendored）的 tree-sitter 语法（162 种语言）+ AST 提取引擎 安全性 每个版本在发布前都会通过多层流水线进行验证：
